query: Consider the following context: During the hot dip aluminum plating process, components such as sinking rollers, pulling rollers, and guide plates will come into long-term contact with high-temperature liquid aluminum and be corroded by the aluminum liquid, greatly reducing their service life. In that context, which material can be used for prepare parts for the dipping and plating equipment and protect the equipment from erosion, and why?

generation.hypothesis: Nickel-based alloys can be used to prepare parts for the dipping and plating equipment to protect it from erosion in the hot dip aluminum plating process.
generation.material_initial_state: Nickel-based alloy in its solid state
generation.intervention: Immersion in high-temperature liquid aluminum at 700°C for an extended period
generation.conditions: High-temperature environment, in contact with liquid aluminum
generation.structural_mediator: Formation of a protective oxide layer on the surface of the nickel-based alloy
generation.mechanism: The nickel-based alloy reacts with the oxygen in the air to form a thin, dense, and adherent oxide layer, which acts as a barrier to prevent the penetration of liquid aluminum and reduce corrosion
generation.predicted_outcome: A 30% increase in service life of the equipment components compared to the current materials, with a corrosion rate of less than 0.1 mm/year
generation.baseline: Current materials used for equipment components
generation.boundary: Temperature range of 600-800°C, and exposure time of up to 100 hours
generation.uncertainty: The actual performance of the nickel-based alloy may vary depending on the specific composition, processing conditions, and operating environment

falsification_experiment.design: Immersion test of nickel-based alloy samples in high-temperature liquid aluminum
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the corrosion rate of the nickel-based alloy is greater than 0.5 mm/year, or the service life of the equipment components does not increase by at least 20% compared to the current materials, then the hypothesis is falsified
